single.note: One synaptic event (Exp2Syn, 5 nS) at each site, every 10 um.

bias.note: Steady somatic current as a fraction of each cell's rheobase, applied throughout the simulation; the cell is free to fire.

noise.note: Somatic current = mean (fraction of rheobase) + Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise; paired trials with and without the synapse share the same noise.

mechanism.note: Condition used for the threshold, decay-time and gating analyses: robust events.
